request: Redesign the Sketch & area edits section (1899:118752) with Mobbin references, via /design:design-critique, and build proposed mockups next to the originals.
critique: Sketch is the only workspace drawn as a bare page (title, two floating canvases, loose controls). Every other surface uses the approved panel system: Conversation, Media viewer and Editor stage twins with a recessed monitor and a docked toolbar.

Sketch controls are spread over five zones: Leave Sketch top right, the tool strip centred under the drawing, the prompt field under the tool strip, status text plus Start/Pause under the preview, and Accept on the far right.
The prompt is a 32px search-style field parked under the tool strip, away from the output it drives.
'Your drawing', 'Displayed preview' and 'Last successful preview' are meta labels; the two halves explain themselves.

States are signalled twice: M15 says 'Last successful preview' under the picture and 'Last good preview' beside Retry; M19 says 'Connecting to the preview…' in the frame and 'Connecting...' beside it.

State is coloured text (green 'Live preview', orange 'Last good preview' / 'Preview allowance reached') instead of the notice tone system, and 'Check allowance' does not say what happens; the client resumes on its own at the reset.
The canvases are 4:3 (584 x 440) while the realtime model renders 512 x 512 squares (client SNAPSHOT_SIZE), and the halves sit 56px apart, so sketch and result are hard to compare.

Accept opens a 424px side sheet that starts 56px below the top, covers the preview and its controls and is mostly empty; 'Saving this image' narrates a backend stage and 'Back to Sketch' repeats the close button.
'Leave Sketch' duplicates the rail; leaving is already safe because the drawing is checkpointed (WSC M08).
M10 takes over the page to paint, hiding the conversation and composer: the creator paints, leaves, and only then types the instruction.
M10's footer 'Desk v2 · 1344 × 768' is an info row and contradicts its own layer name (1536 × 1024).
The painted area is an opaque lavender blob (45%, no edge), so the content being changed is hidden.
M12 shows a normal state as a warning notice ('Area selected on Desk v2' + 'Review area'), uses a Review X button and repeats the composer's Mask tile, while the viewer does not show the area at all.
The Mask tile shows a yellow brush glyph instead of the area; yellow is the focus ring colour.
M12's composer offers a selectable '1:1' shape and a '1 image' count, but the only edit-image profile (flux-kontext-fast) fixes aspectRatio to match_input_image and returns one image.
Capability gap: no capability profile accepts a mask input (flux-kontext-fast takes exactly one primary image) and CONTEXT.md keeps the dedicated image editor deferred.

references.pattern: Realtime drawing and output joined edge to edge on one surface, one composer at the bottom, output actions under the output. Basis for the joined pair and the docked console.
Before and after compared on one surface with no captions.
Erase/Restore, brush size, undo and the edit prompt with Submit on the same screen as the image. Basis for painting in place beside the composer.
Selection and brush tools docked under the image; the image stays where it was.
Translucent area over the picture, brush size and one action beside it.
Tools in one strip, prompt bar and Generate docked at the bottom of the canvas.

proposal.section: Sketch & area edits · Proposed (2301:2675) at y=2400, directly below the originals; each proposal sits at its original's x/y inside the section.
sketch: One full-width stage panel: Vidra Fresh / Editor stage instance at 64,64, 1368 x 828 (T-screen geometry), header and timeline hidden.

Preview slot: recessed Monitor (surface/canvas, radius/media, Ambient blur of the output at 35%) holding a 640 x 640 drawing and a 640 x 640 output joined edge to edge, square like the 512 x 512 realtime frame.
Toolbar slot: one docked row — Toolbar / Sketch tools (transparent) | divider | Prompt (Vidra Fresh / Field, fills the row) | divider | Save image (primary).

The output owns its state: Off = centred Start preview; Connecting = the same button loading 'Starting preview…'; Live = Pause on the output; Error = Notice Danger 'Preview stopped updating' + Retry, last good frame kept; Limit = Notice Warning 'Preview limit resets at 7:00 PM', no Pause, Save image stays enabled.

Save image replaces 'Accept this image'. Saving and Saved show a 336 x 112 popover anchored 6px above Save image, right edges aligned, built like the Export panel: captured thumbnail + 'Saving image…' / 'Saved to Evening campaign', action 'Use as input' (disabled until saved).
Removed: page title, Leave Sketch, the three captions, coloured status text, the Sketch status component, the side sheet and Back to Sketch.
areaEdit: M10: painting happens in the right panel. An Editor stage (992 x 828 at 440,64) holds the picture and the area, with Toolbar / Mask docked in its Toolbar slot (transparent, tools left, Done right as Secondary, Cancel removed). The conversation and composer stay visible, so the instruction can be typed and Edit image pressed while painting.
M12: Media viewer without the header notice; the area is drawn on the picture.
Area style: tint (overlay/mask at 28% layer opacity) plus a 1.5px overlay/mask edge.
Composer: the Mask tile shows the picture with the area; the shape chip is a fixed '16:9' with no chevron; the '1 image' chip is hidden.

decisions: Keep the area-edit pair (M10, M12) as a forward design (Bryce, 2026-10-16), although no capability profile accepts a mask input yet.
